deck.title: Bob Modernization Factory — AngelHack IBM Bob Hackathon 2026

props.title:
**Bob Modernization Factory**
Legacy modernization with the ==brakes built in==.
props.subtitle: A controlled, build-gated pipeline for modernizing legacy code with IBM Bob.

slides.notes: Set the frame in one line: we didn't build another AI rewriter — we built the assembly line that makes AI rewrites safe to run.

props.title: AI modernization is usually **one giant rewrite** — breaking in ==a hundred places at once==.
props.body: No checkpoints. No proof each step still builds. No way to stop halfway and ship something that works.

slides.notes: Everyone has watched an agent get 80% through a rewrite and die. You're left with a half-migrated codebase and no safe path back.

right.label: The factory
right.title: Gated stations
points: Code moves through stations: assess, plan, transform, verify
A build gate at every station
Stop at any point with a working codebase

slides.notes: The metaphor is the pitch: a factory line doesn't move faster by skipping inspection — it moves faster because nothing broken gets downstream.

items.title: Inventory
items.body: Map the legacy surface — routes, middleware, dependencies.

items.title: Plan
items.body: Generate a modernization plan with IBM Bob, one station at a time.

items.title: Transform
items.body: Apply small, isolated transformations — never a big bang.

items.title: Verify
items.body: Run the build after each one. A failed gate halts the line instead of shipping breakage.

slides.notes: Walk the loop once out loud: plan a small change, apply it, build, green means the line advances, red means the line stops right there.

props.caption: Express Gateway — a real legacy Node.js API gateway, modernized end-to-end through the pipeline.

slides.notes: This isn't a toy repo. Express Gateway is a real, production-era codebase — if the pipeline handles it, the pattern generalizes.

tiles.title: Build gates
tiles.body: Every transformation must pass a build before the line advances.

tiles.title: Halt, don't ship
tiles.body: A failed gate stops the pipeline with the last good state intact.

tiles.title: Incremental steps
tiles.body: Small, reviewable transformations instead of one untraceable diff.

tiles.title: Full inventory
tiles.body: Bob maps the legacy surface before a single line changes.

slides.notes: Hit the two features judges care about: gates that actually block the line, and a codebase that's always shippable between stations.
Everything you're seeing is real and submitted. Offer the demo here — three minutes, gate failure included.
